label: rare: around <DEL>/early copy in sequences rich in k/r/y/c, often while outputting k
explanation: Very sparse feature (~0.008% of steps, 973 seqs). It never fires at t<=3 or on L=3, and 87% of its mass is at the delimiter and early copy steps (recall_idx 0-3, mostly t=9-10 in long L=8-9 sequences). Common inputs at firing are s, k, v, t, w and <DEL>; 59% of mass falls on steps that output k, and the original sequences tend to have k/r/y/c in their early positions. Every token-level predicate tried has precision of about 1% or less: out_tok==k catches 59% of mass at 0.3% precision, and conjunctions with input sets and prefix k/r/y/c counts reach at most ~2% F1. Magnitude does not follow any variable I checked. The feature probably reads a rare hidden-state configuration that these variables do not capture. It does not fire in the early original phase or in sequences that copy incorrectly.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: out_tok=k (+4.90), phase=2 & in_tok=k (+4.57), in_tok=s (+3.30), in_tok=w (+3.10), phase=2 & in_tok=s (+2.94), in_tok=t (+2.73). Lower it: correct=1 (-4.71), recall_idx=5 (-2.58), prev3_tok=- (-2.15), prev_tok=k (-1.51).
